description: Bonescythe Bracers Level 60 Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Bracers if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bracers, 6 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar, 2 Cured Rugged Hides and 10 gold pieces. Requirements: - Desecrated Bracers - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 6 - Arcanite Bar - Cured Rugged Hide x 2 - Money: 10
